title: Jensen Huang Is Back, and So Is His Plaque at Denny’s
summary: The chain said it had restored a plaque honoring Mr. Huang above a booth in San Jose, Calif., where he is said to have developed the idea for Nvidia.
caption: A plaque above a booth at a Denny’s in San Jose, Calif., ties the location to Nvidia’s origin story.

title: Nvidia Halts Sales to Southeast Asia as U.S. Tightens China Restrictions
summary: The shipping halt, which hit four countries, follows a new U.S. rule that would require licenses for companies in the countries to buy advanced A.I. chips.
caption: Data center operators in Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia have had Nvidia orders put on hold.

title: Why Some A.I. Evangelists Aren’t Bothered by the Potential for Human Extinction
summary: Understanding the set of beliefs that drives the Silicon Valley vanguard.

title: How A.I. Is Transforming Mathematics
summary: “One thing that A.I. has done is that it’s given us answers without insight, without understanding.”
authors: Max Read, Whitney Jones, Sawyer Roque, Vjeran Pavic, Chris Wood, Dan Powell, Elisheba Ittoop, Marion Lozano, Sophia Lanman and Rowan Niemisto
